children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
How long do Vaporesso LUXE X pods last?
A Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pod usually lasts
one to two weeks

of moderate vaping before flavour drops off. Low power, nic salts and 50/50 liquid in the 0.6Ω pod stretch that; sweet shortfills at high power in the 0.4Ω pod shorten it. Change the pod at the first burnt or muted hit.
What pods are compatible with the Vaporesso LUXE X?
The Vaporesso LUXE X takes three pod types: these
Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pods
, the standard Vaporesso LUXE X mesh pods from 0.3Ω to 0.8Ω, and the empty Vaporesso LUXE XR pods with a GTX coil. All share one magnetic base and also fit the LUXE X2, X3 and XR Max kits.
Do all Vaporesso pods fit the same?
No. Vaporesso pods are platform specific. LUXE X series pods, including the Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pods, fit
LUXE X, X2, X3, X Pro and XR kits only
. Vaporesso LUXE Q, XROS and GTX pods use different bases and will not seat in a LUXE X kit. See all
Vaporesso replacement pods
What is the difference between the 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pods?
Resistance decides the draw. The
Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pod runs at higher power for a looser restricted lung draw and warmer vapour. The
pod runs cooler for a tighter mouth-to-lung draw, uses less battery and e-liquid, and suits nic salts. Both pods fit the same kits.
What is the difference between 0.6 and 0.8 Vaporesso pods?

The 0.6Ω Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pod gives a medium, slightly open mouth-to-lung draw with more vapour, while the 0.8Ω standard Vaporesso LUXE X mesh pod is tighter and cooler, closest to a cigarette.
There is no 0.8Ω dual mesh pod
; for that draw choose the standard Vaporesso LUXE X 0.8Ω mesh pod.
Why does my Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pod taste burnt?
A burnt hit on a new Vaporesso LUXE X Dual Mesh Pod almost always means it was not primed. Fill it,
wait at least 10 minutes
, and start on low power. On a used pod, a burnt taste with e-liquid still inside means the mesh has gummed up with sweetener, so replace the pod.
